attchmntText: Mukka Proteins Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Mukka Proteins Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its Q2 and FY27 unaudited financial results for the period ended 30th September 2026. The company reported an export revenue share of 81.3% for Q2 FY27. It commenced commercial production at its new Al Juba facility in Oman during the quarter. The firm secured US FDA facility registration for its Oman and Mangaluru facilities. Mukka Proteins holds approximately 25 to 30% market share in fish meal and fish oil revenue. The company targets revenue growth from 1,449 crore rupees in FY26 to over 3,000 crore rupees by FY30. It operates 18 owned in-house production facilities in India and Oman. The presentation highlights a strategic shift toward an integrated animal protein and sustainability platform.

attchmntText: Mukka Proteins Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Mukka Proteins Limited has approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 7th November 2026. The company published newspaper advertisements for these results in Business Standard and Vijaya Karnataka on 9th November 2026. The full financial results and the Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: Mukka Proteins Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "Mukka Proteins Reports Strong Q2 FY27 PerformanceOman Facility Commences Commercial ProductionU.S. FDA Facility Registration Strengthens Market AccessUSDA NOP Inputs Attestation for Eco Sphere Organic Fertilizer.
voiceSummary: Mukka Proteins Limited filed a press release regarding its financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 increased 108.06% year-on-year to 5,088.70 Mn rupees. Profit after tax stood at 177.27 Mn rupees, up 157.51% year-on-year. The company reported that its Oman facility has commenced commercial production. This expansion increased the group’s total manufacturing capacity from 291,720 MTPA to 340,170 MTPA. The company also secured U.S. FDA facility registration. Additionally, USDA NOP Inputs Attestation was received for Eco Sphere Organic Fertilizer. CARE Ratings revised the outlook to Stable from Negative. The company noted that certain shipments were deferred to October 2026 due to geopolitical disruptions.

attchmntText: Mukka Proteins Limited has informed the Exchange about revision of terms of investment in Swachha Eco Solutions Private Limited.
voiceSummary: Mukka Proteins Limited has revised the terms of its strategic investment in Swachha Eco Solutions Private Limited. The Board of Directors approved the acquisition of 85,200 equity shares for a total consideration not exceeding Rs. 2,13,00,000. This investment represents a 46% stake in the investee company. The shares are priced at Rs. 250 each. The transaction is structured as a cash acquisition. The target entity operates in the waste management sector. Its turnover for the fiscal year 2025-26 was Rs. 1,77,61,136. The acquisition is not a related party transaction. Completion is expected by 31st March 2027. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Mukka Proteins Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Mukka Proteins Limited filed a statement of deviation or variation in the utilization of funds raised through a preferential issue of warrants for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company confirms there has been no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds. The preferential issue was allotted on 09/09/2026, raising Rs. 47,00,00,000. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement on 7th November 2026. Funds were allocated for working capital requirements, business expansion plans, and general corporate purposes. The original allocation for working capital was Rs. 35,00,00,000, with Rs. 11,75,00,000 utilized. Allocations for business expansion and general corporate purposes were Rs. 5,00,00,000 and Rs. 7,00,00,000 respectively, with no utilization reported for these categories. The monitoring agency is not applicable.

attchmntText: Mukka Proteins Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Mukka Proteins Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 7th November 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations stood at 9,700.86 million for the half year, with a profit after tax of 363.61 million. Earnings per share were 1.16. The Board also approved revised investment terms in Swaccha Eco Solutions Private Limited. The company will subscribe to 85,200 equity shares at 250 rupees per share, totaling 2,13,00,000 rupees. This acquisition represents 46 percent of paid-up capital, making Swaccha Eco Solutions Private Limited an associate.
